Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to identify and confirm the birth year of the director of "Monster A-Go-Go" (Bill Rebane) in step 2. While the task required identifying all directors for both films and comparing their birth years, WebSurfer focused excessively on Pasquale Festa Campanile's birth year (already widely cited as 1927) but neglected to gather authoritative information for the director(s) of "Monster A-Go-Go." This oversight prevented a proper comparison of the directors' ages, leading to the inability to correctly solve the real-world problem.
